import unittest

from solution import numbered_message


class NumberedMessageTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_count_start_and_format(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            numbered_message("hello", 3),
            ["1: hello", "2: hello", "3: hello"],
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            numbered_message("item", 3, -2),
            ["-2: item", "-1: item", "0: item"],
        )

    def test_zero_count_returns_fresh_empty_list(self):
        first = numbered_message("x", 0)
        second = numbered_message("x", 0, 99)
        self.assertEqual(first, [])
        self.assertEqual(second, [])
        self.assertIsNot(first, second)

    def test_each_nonempty_call_returns_fresh_list(self):
        first = numbered_message("x", 1)
        second = numbered_message("x", 1)
        self.assertEqual(first, second)
        self.assertIsNot(first, second)
        first.append("changed")
        self.assertEqual(second, ["1: x"])

    def test_message_validation(self):
        for bad in [None, 1, False, [], b"x"]:
            with self.subTest(message=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    numbered_message(bad, 1)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            numbered_message("", 1)

    def test_count_and_start_type_validation(self):
        for bad in [True, False, 1.0, "1", None]:
            with self.subTest(count=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    numbered_message("x", bad)
            with self.subTest(start=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    numbered_message("x", 1, bad)

    def test_negative_count(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            numbered_message("x", -1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
